name: Wild Salmon
description: Wild salmon is a premier, marine-derived therapeutic whole food matrix. Globally renowned for its unparalleled concentration of anti-inflammatory Omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA), high-biological-value protein, and the legendary carotenoid antioxidant *astaxanthin*, it serves as an elite functional resource for neuro-vascular integrity, cellular recovery, and metabolic architecture.
macroIntro: The macronutrient profile of wild salmon provides an optimized distribution of complete structural proteins and clean marine lipids, engineered for sustained energy delivery and deep muscle preservation.
microIntro: Salmon contains an exceptional network of fat-soluble vitamins, mitochondrial coenzymes, and vital trace minerals that drive endogenous antioxidant networks and optimize thyroid conversion pathways.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: Provides moderate, clean biological energy derived from a pristine balance of structural amino acids and healthy anti-inflammatory fats.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: An elite complete protein source containing all essential amino acids required for rapid muscular synthesis, tissue remodeling, and enzymatic manufacturing.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: Dominated by highly fluid monounsaturated fats and essential polyunsaturated Omega-3 fatty acids that optimize vascular linings and brain cell structures.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Completely free of carbohydrates, fibers, or starches, ensuring an absolute zero impact on blood glucose curves or insulin shifts.

microNutrients.name: Omega-3 (EPA/DHA)
microNutrients.description: A monumental dose of pre-formed Eicosapentaenoic and Docosahexaenoic acids, which structurally integrate into cellular lipid bilayers to lower systemic inflammation.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B12 (Cobalamin)
microNutrients.description: An abundant animal-bound vitamin critical for maintaining the nerve myelin sheath, optimizing red blood cell production, and preventing cognitive fatigue.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)
microNutrients.description: A rare natural food source of active Cholecalciferol, functioning as a master hormone to lock calcium securely into bones and modulate white blood cell paths.

microNutrients.name: Selenium
microNutrients.description: An essential trace mineral cofactor required for glutathione peroxidase activation, defending blood vessel walls and converting thyroid hormones.

microNutrients.name: Astaxanthin
microNutrients.description: A powerful marine carotenoid responsible for salmon's deep pink hue. It spans the entire cell membrane to aggressively scavenge free radicals.

microNutrients.name: Potassium
microNutrients.description: A vital intracellular electrolyte that drives the sodium-potassium pump, lowering peripheral vascular tension and stabilizing electrical resting heart rates.

healthBenefits: Neuro-Vascular & Endothelial Protection: Staggering concentrations of EPA and DHA actively lower circulating triglycerides, reduce overall arterial plaque accumulation markers, and preserve pristine endothelial lining flexibility.

Advanced Neuro-Axonal Endurance: High Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) reserves combine with massive Cobalamin (B12) pools to support structural gray matter architecture, optimize synaptic signaling speeds, and protect cognitive clarity.

Systemic Anti-Inflammatory Cascade: The unique pairing of long-chain Omega-3s with *astaxanthin* powerfully suppresses inflammatory cytokines, mitigating joint stiffness and protecting dermal cells from oxidative UV breakdown.

Skeletal Framework & Muscle Architecture: Natural Vitamin D3 facilitates hyper-efficient intestinal calcium absorption, working in perfect synergy with salmon's elite amino acid profile to lock minerals into bones and fuel lean muscular tissue repair.
precautionsIntro: Even though wild salmon is an unmatched functional resource, certain environmental marine elements and unique lipid structures require careful management metrics.
precautions: Marine Environmental Mercury Tracking: While wild salmon ranks exceptionally low in heavy metal bioconcentration compared to apex predators (like tuna or swordfish), regular screening of sourcing vectors is wise to ensure absolute systemic purity.

Purine Concentration Parameters: Salmon contains moderate to high levels of natural purines. If you navigate a clinical history of gout or hyperuricemia, daily serving frequencies must be carefully balanced to prevent uric acid crystallization in joint structures.

Wild vs. Industrial Farmed Profiles: Conventionally farmed salmon is frequently raised in crowded net-pens, resulting in drastically lower Omega-3 to Omega-6 ratios, potential exposure to synthetic antibiotics, and artificial dye treatments. Wild-caught or high-grade organic options are heavily preferred.

Parasitic Nematode Risks in Raw Formats: Consuming raw or undercooked salmon (such as in sashimi or ceviche) carries a distinct risk of containing live marine parasites like *Anisakis*. Ensuring the fish has undergone explicit blast-freezing treatments completely neutralizes this biological hazard.
